extDescription.message: Private team voice channel during a Teams meeting, driven by your Teams microphone state.

hintDevices.message: Grant microphone access to list your audio devices.

listenLabel.message: Listen to the team even when the Teams mic is live

talkTeam.message: Teams mic muted: you are talking to your team.

talkClient.message: Teams mic live: you are talking to the client.

hintHeadset.message: Tip: wear a headset to avoid any leak to the client.

errRequiredFields.message: Server, team code and name are required.

errMicPermission.message: Microphone access is blocked for the extension. Grant it once, then connect again.

errMicMissing.message: No microphone found on this machine.

errMicFailed.message: The microphone could not be opened. Another app may be using it.

errBadServerUrl.message: Invalid server URL. It must start with ws:// or wss://

errServerUnreachable.message: Cannot reach the signaling server. Is it running at that address?

permIntro.message: OffMic captures your microphone from a background document, which has no interface and therefore cannot show a permission prompt. Grant access once here and Chrome will remember it for the extension.

permGranted.message: Access granted. Open the OffMic popup and click Connect.

permDenied.message: Access denied. Open the padlock in the address bar and allow the microphone, then try again.

permCloseHint.message: You can close this tab once access is granted.

errOffscreenFailed.message: Internal error: the microphone document could not start. Reload the extension.

errNoTeamsTab.message: OffMic needs your Teams meeting tab to be open. Open it, then connect again.

errNoResponse.message: No response from the extension. Reload it from chrome://extensions, then try again.
